family.tagline: Three generations, one Companion Core and a river behind the house.
family.story: Yoshiko cooks for the whole house, and Haruo, a retired surveyor, keeps his record collection and his photographs. Their daughter Emi writes software upstairs, nine-year-old Kenji studies down the hall, and baby Sora sleeps in the nursery. One Companion Core sits on a credenza in the Family Room.

companion.name: Cinnamon
companion.job: Drafts recipe cards from the steps Yoshiko messages to it.
companion.limits: Drafts only. Yoshiko reads every card and saves it herself.

members.name: Haruo
members.work: retired surveyor, keeps a record collection

companion.name: Sesame
companion.job: Drafts captions for Haruo’s photographs from the notes he sends.
companion.limits: Drafts only. Haruo reads every caption and adds it himself.

companion.name: Chestnut
companion.job: Drafts issue write-ups from the errors and notes Emi sends.
companion.limits: Drafts only. Emi reads each write-up and files it herself.

popup.title: Kenji holds the door for Haruo
popup.body: A Companion Core arrives in a parcel at the top of three stone steps. Haruo carries it inside, and Kenji holds the door.

popup.title: Unbox the Companion Core
popup.body: Inside: the Companion Core, a power cable, a quick-start guide and a recovery USB drive. Yoshiko clears the credenza, and Emi lifts the Core out.

popup.title: Plug it in
popup.body: Haruo plugs in the cable, and Kenji presses the button. The Core wakes and opens its own Wi-Fi network.

popup.title: Join it from a phone
popup.body: Emi opens the Wi-Fi settings on her phone and joins the Core’s own network. Then she chooses the home network.

popup.title: Pick the first agent and apps
popup.body: In the Companion Hub store, Yoshiko picks Hermes, and the family adds HomeHub and Immich. Then they walk away.

beats.capability: talks to you through the messaging platform you pick, on your Core

popup.title: Cinnamon answers the first message
popup.body: Yoshiko messages the agent she named Cinnamon. Cinnamon answers from the Core on the credenza.
popup.note: Messages pass through the chat service you choose.

say.speaker: yoshiko
say.text: Good morning, Yoshiko. I am Cinnamon. Which recipe comes first?

beats.capability: stream your own music collection to any device

popup.title: Haruo plays the clean copy
popup.body: Side two of his favourite record skips. Haruo plays the copy he digitised himself, served by Navidrome from his own collection on the Core.

beats.capability: listen to your audiobooks and podcasts, and pick up where you left off

popup.title: Kenji picks up where he stopped
popup.body: After school Kenji settles on the sofa and presses play. The family’s own audiobooks come from the Core, and Audiobookshelf keeps his place.

beats.capability: write a wiki or a set of manuals in books, chapters and pages, with search and history

popup.title: Haruo types up the field books
popup.body: Old survey field books fill the low shelf. Haruo types them into BookStack, one book for each survey, and the wiki sits on the Core, with search.

beats.capability: talks to you through the messaging platform you pick, on your Core

popup.title: Haruo corrects Sesame’s caption
popup.body: The willow photograph has no caption yet. Haruo messages Sesame the date and light, and Sesame drafts one on the Core. Haruo corrects the lens and adds it himself.
popup.note: Messages pass through the chat service you choose.

say.speaker: haruo
say.text: Here is the caption. Please read it and correct what is wrong.

beats.capability: turn text into natural speech on your own Core

popup.title: Kenji hears his river line
popup.body: Haruo says rivers meander, so Kenji writes a line about one. He types it into Kokoro, hears the Core turn it into speech, then reads it to Haruo.

beats.capability: a whiteboard with a hand-drawn look; sketch ideas together

popup.title: Kenji sketches a water wheel
popup.body: Beside the toy box, Kenji sketches a school water wheel in Excalidraw. Haruo, a retired surveyor, adds the measurements, and the board is served from the Core.

beats.capability: control and automate your smart home from one place, locally

popup.title: Yoshiko sets the morning lamp
popup.body: Yoshiko sets the nursery globe lamp to come up warm at seven each morning. Home Assistant runs the rule from the Core, and the app needs no cloud account.

beats.capability: a shared household hub for notes, shopping, chores and expenses, with a recipe book

popup.title: Emi adds nappies to the list
popup.body: Nappies run low on the changing table. Emi adds them to the HomeHub shopping list, and Yoshiko sees the line before her market run.

beats.capability: plan tasks and time blocks in one local file on your Core

popup.title: Emi plans around the nap
popup.body: Between calls, Emi blocks Tuesday’s quiet work hours around Sora’s nap. Companion Planning stores the week as a local file on the Core.

beats.capability: host private Git repositories, pull requests and issues on your Core

popup.title: Emi commits Kenji’s first quiz
popup.body: Emi and Kenji code a river quiz on her bed, and she commits it to Gitea. The history sits on the Core, not on a rented code host.

beats.capability: talks to you through the messaging platform you pick, on your Core

popup.title: Emi files the issue herself
popup.body: At her writing desk, Emi sends Chestnut an error and her notes. Chestnut drafts the write-up on the Core’s local model. Emi reads it, then files it herself.
popup.note: Messages pass through the chat service you choose.

say.speaker: emi
say.text: Here is the issue. Please read it before you file it.

beats.capability: talks to you through the messaging platform you pick, on your Core

popup.title: Yoshiko writes down her mother’s pickles
popup.body: Stirring brine at the range, Yoshiko messages Cinnamon the steps as she remembers them. Cinnamon drafts a recipe card, and Yoshiko corrects the salt and saves it herself.
popup.note: Messages pass through the chat service you choose.

say.speaker: yoshiko
say.text: Here is the card. Please check the salt and the steps.

beats.capability: a shared household hub for notes, shopping, chores and expenses, with a recipe book

popup.title: Yoshiko enters the market bill
popup.body: The week’s market receipt lands on the counter. Yoshiko enters it in the HomeHub expense tracker, and Emi reads the spending on the Core.

beats.capability: a shared household hub for notes, shopping, chores and expenses, with a recipe book

popup.title: Haruo finds the boiler steps
popup.body: The boiler stops one cold morning, and Haruo finds the reset steps in the HomeHub notes. Yoshiko typed them from the curling paper note by the fridge.

beats.capability: back up, search and organise your family photos and videos on your own Core

popup.title: Haruo photographs the willow again
popup.body: Each month Haruo photographs the same willow from the same spot, like a survey. Immich keeps each month’s picture in one timeline, from a library on the Core.
popup.note: Immich sorts the pictures, so its first start takes a while.

beats.capability: a local video recorder with object detection for your IP cameras

popup.title: Yoshiko checks when the geese came
popup.body: On Wednesday morning, Yoshiko scrolls the lawn camera’s Frigate clips to see when the geese came back. The camera is the family’s own, and the clips sit on the Core.

popup.title: One Core for three generations
popup.body: Records, recipes, code and homework share one Companion Core in the brick house beside the river.

closing.body: Your records, recipes, photographs and code can sit on a Companion Core at home. Browse the Companion Hub store and pick your first apps.

notes: The house has no TV, kitchen island or fireplace. The couch media beat is Kenji’s audiobook on the Family Room sofa; Haruo’s record beat anchors on the record player.
Sora is a baby: no archetype, no companion. The validator needs one beat with member sora, so nursery-list is hers; Emi acts in it. She also appears in the planning beat.
garden-geese assumes an IP camera the family owns on the lawn (not part of the Core); nothing shows a person.
Home Assistant runs the nursery lamp only if the bulb is a network device; no hub stick is implied. The no-cloud-account line is about the app, not the lamp.
All three companions are Hermes. The chat-service note rides on every Hermes beat; Companion Memory is not named.

Immich first-start caveat rides in the note of garden-willow. Excalidraw is amd64 only (catalog caveat). BookStack and Excalidraw were picked because HortusFox, Open WebUI and Obsidian are already over the fleet cap.
Chapters follow the walk: Family Room (east, ground floor), Bedroom Three, the Nursery, Bedroom Two, then down to the Kitchen and out to the pond lawn.
